full_judgment: 3. The plaint case, in short, was that the laud measuring 1912 decimals appertaining to mouza Bagura Alekanda in J.L. No. 50 under C.S. Khatian Nos. 160 and 178, plot No. 1548 belonged to Gobinda Chandra Shil. He executed a will and appointed his wife Sona Lakhahmi as executrix. Defendant No. 3, Ramesh Chandra Shil was the next reversioner. After death of Gobinda Chandra Shil, Sona Lakhshmi obtained probate in Probate Case No. 6 of 1917 filed before the District Judge, Barisal. Sona Lakhshmi and the reversionary heir leased out the said land to Dinabandhu Gangopadhya (father of defendant Nos. 1and 2) by patta dated 05.11.1941 for legal necessity and delivered Possession thereof. In the said patta by mistake plot No. 1549 was written instead of plot No. 1548, but the boundaries and the area of the land were correctly written. Since the said pattan defendant Nos. 1 and 2 had been residing on the suit land constructing dwelling structures thereon and on payment of rent, municipal tax etc. The said defendants transferred the suit property to the plaintiffs by a registered sale deed dated 12.05 1970, but in that sale deed also mistakenly plot No. 1549 was written in lieu of plot No. 1548. During R.S. operation the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of defendant No. 3 and her mother Sona Lakhshmi although they had never claimed the same. Husband of defendant No. 6 in collusion with Sudhir Chandra Dutta, an employee of defendant No. 5 constructed structures on plot No. 804, and as such, the plaint was amended incorporating prayer for recovery of khas possession in respect of 'Kha' schedule land. The collusively prepared wrong record in the name of No. 3 and her mother has clouded title of the plaintiffs in the suit land and hence the suit.
